s.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate with 20g butter. Stir smooth and chill 3 hours. Scoop and roll into balls and coat in cocoa, crushed peanuts or sprinkles.

Rub 80g butter into 150g flour, add 150g grated cheddar, a pinch of smoked paprika and cayenne, and bring together. Roll into a log and chill an hour. Slice into coins and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden.

m.note: the Fratellis' hideout in the old restaurant
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with 200g crushed tomatoes mixed with garlic and oregano. Top with crumbled sausage from 3 Italian sausages, 150g sliced mushrooms and 250g mozzarella. Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes.

w.note: One-Eyed Willy's ship, full of gold
w.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate with 150g butter, whisk in 3 eggs and 150g sugar and fold in 150g self-raising flour. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes. Cut off the top, hollow out, fill with chocolate coins, replace the lid and cover in ganache of 100g chocolate and 100ml cream.

d.note: the kids' summer on the docks
d.how: Put two scoops of vanilla ice cream in each of four tall glasses. Pour a 375ml can of root beer slowly over each until it foams to the top. Serve with long spoons.
